smsSettings.title: SMS Settings
smsSettings.subtitle: Send text messages (farm invitations and reminders). Many farm workers have no email, so SMS is their main channel.
smsSettings.loadFailed: Could not load the SMS settings.
smsSettings.saveFailed: Could not save the SMS settings.
smsSettings.testError: Could not send the test message.
smsSettings.statusOff: SMS is switched off - no text messages are being sent
smsSettings.dltNote: In India, text messages need DLT registration (a registered sender name and approved message templates) with your SMS provider. When that is done, enter the details here and switch SMS on. Nothing needs to be deployed.

providers.log: Test only (writes to the server log, sends nothing)

fields.defaultCountryCode: Country code for numbers typed without one (91 = India)

smsSettings.secretSet: A value is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
smsSettings.templateHint: Variables: {inviter} {farm} {role} {link}. The text must match the DLT-approved template.
smsSettings.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet.
smsSettings.saveFirst: Save your changes first, then send a test.
smsSettings.testHint: Sends a sample invitation to the number below, so you can check the settings work before real invitations depend on them.
smsSettings.testSent: Test sent. It should arrive shortly.
smsSettings.testLogged: Written to the server log only (the provider is set to Test only).
smsSettings.testFailed: The provider did not accept it: {{reason}}
